meta.title: Record {id}
meta.description: ADA registry record {id}: certification status as of the time it is retrieved.

link.current: This is the holder's current certificate.
link.retired: The holder has retired in good standing.
link.withdrawn: This certificate is no longer valid.
link.replaced: It was replaced by <id>{number}</id> on {date}. The holder's current standing is below.
link.replacedNoCurrent: It was replaced by a newer certificate. The holder's current standing is below.

standing.title: Standing
standing.goodBody: Holds an active ADA credential. No suspension, revocation or other public action is in effect.
standing.retiredBody: Not practicing as ADA-certified. No suspension, revocation or other public action is in effect.
standing.lapsedOne: Was ADA-certified. The {credential} certification was not renewed by {date}. This is an administrative lapse, not a disciplinary action.
standing.lapsedOneNoDate: Was ADA-certified. The {credential} certification has expired. This is an administrative lapse, not a disciplinary action.
standing.lapsedMany: Was ADA-certified. The certifications below were not renewed. This is an administrative lapse, not a disciplinary action.
standing.suspendedBody: {count, plural, one {The {credentials} certification is suspended.} other {The {credentials} certifications are suspended.}} Not ADA-certified during the suspension.
standing.revokedBodyOn: The {credentials} certification was revoked on {date}. Not ADA-certified.
standing.revokedBody: {count, plural, one {The {credentials} certification was revoked.} other {The {credentials} certifications were revoked.}} Not ADA-certified.
standing.note: Standing is computed from every credential below and any public action in effect.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.empty: No ADA credential is on record. The certificate history is below.
credentials.note: Only credentials ADA has issued appear here. Exam results, applications and complaints under review are never public.

meaning.active: Meets ADA certification requirements. No end date.
meaning.expiredBy: Not renewed by {date}. Not currently ADA-certified.
meaning.suspended: Suspended. Not ADA-certified during the suspension.
meaning.retired: Retired in good standing. Not practicing as ADA-certified.

history.title: Certificate history
history.empty: No certificate is on file for this record.

about.title: About this record
about.primary: Primary source. This page is the ADA registry's official record and the primary source for ADA certification status. A certificate shows status on the day it was issued; this page shows status now.
about.currency: Currency. Reflects the registry at the time shown above. Changes are recorded by ADA registry staff.
about.use: Use. For verification only. Not for solicitation or marketing lists.
about.corrections: Corrections. If something on this record looks wrong, contact {email}.

mobile.aboutPrimary: This page is the primary source for ADA certification status. A paper certificate shows status on the day it was issued.
mobile.aboutUse: For verification only. Not for building contact or marketing lists. To correct a record, email <link>{email}</link>.
